exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "Becoming Able to Do Something".

options.text: Verb ようになる (〜you ni naru)
A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
A は B ほど～ない

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! Verb ようになる (〜you ni naru) matches "Becoming Able to Do Something".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is Verb ようになる (〜you ni naru).
exercises.explanation: Expresses a change where someone comes to be able to do something.
